notes.title: Game flow and bug fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44265323/5eac8180b11ad7be8a26c49ee6d0cd6400538066.png[/img]

Game Patch
[list]
[*] New items have been added.
[olist]
[*] Shield: Grants invincibility to the player for a certain duration upon getting hit.
[*] AttackSpeed: Increases attack speed.
[*] Caltrop: When a bomb explodes, it releases 3 Caltrops.
[*] Web : Removing spider webs.
[*] Drone : Temporarily pausing the drone.
[/olist]
[*] Increased item drop probability.
[*] Adjusted boss health and level.
[/list]

optimization
[list]
[*] We have optimized the game to allow only the necessary items to appear.
[/list]

Bug Fix
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where the gauge was filled to 100 when re-entering the game after changing the sound.
[*] Modified the pause function to be available only when the player is active.
[/list]

[h1][b]Add Item[/b][/h1]
Every time you hit the enemy, there's a chance for an item to drop. There are items that provide buffs and others that are weapons. Try out these items to experience more exciting battles!!!

(We are planning to add more items to enhance the fun of the game in the future. Currently, there are not many items, so they might not appear frequently. Please be patient, as we will be adding more soon!)

notes.title: Boss Remake
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44265323/08b553e342884f290e6c73fef7a5f26f0c94796a.png[/img]

[h2][b] Pigmask Remake [/b][/h2]

The logic and skill pattern of the level 3 boss, Pig Mask, has been changed.
From now on, Pigmask will fight in two modes.

Normal mode       : 2 consecutive attacks with guns
Excitement mode : Rushing attack

Initially spawning in normal mode, but when you do certain damage, you switch to excitement mode and rush into the player.
When the rush is over, it returns to normal mode.


[h2][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the attack did not work when the player met the boss invincibly.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44265323/dd4b83e840e3fb002d4eb3da9ef4f26fa67fc705.png[/img]

[h1][b]Bomber Patch[/b][/h1]

We have patched the second boss, Bomber, in Chapter 1. Previously, Bomber's bombs would be placed at the player's position, making it impossible to avoid them when the player performed stationary attacks. We received feedback stating that this made the game progression difficult.

I agreed with this feedback, and in this patch, we have made a modification so that Bomber's bombs no longer explode upon contact with the player's Kunai. They will now pass through without detonating.

notes.title: The level selection feature has been added.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44265323/fa9a15c0fbdb1c69e1783a9fa741adf8c261e694.png[/img]
[h1][b]Game updates[/b][/h1]

[h2]1. Level selection function[/h2]
Now, when you press the game start button, the game does not start right away, but the UI for selecting a level appears.


[h2]2. Attack convenience[/h2]
From now on, if you hold down the attack key, you will continue to attack. The same goes for bomb attacks.

Also, the code for bombs has been simplified and the detonation delay has been reduced.


[h2]3. Balance adjustment[/h2]
The difficulty level was lowered by increasing the level design of the map and the skill cooldown of the final boss.
